ruleDefinitions.name: File Creation In Suspicious Directory By Msdt.EXE
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects msdt.exe creating files in suspicious directories which could be a sign of exploitation of either Follina or Dogwalk vulnerabilities

sequences.query: (process_path = RGX("\\\\msdt\\\.exe$") AND (file_path = RGX(".*\\\\Desktop\\\\.*") OR file_path = RGX(".*\\\\Start\\ Menu\\\\Programs\\\\Startup\\\\.*") OR file_path = RGX(".*C\\:\\\\PerfLogs\\\\.*") OR file_path = RGX(".*C\\:\\\\ProgramData\\\\.*") OR file_path = RGX(".*C\\:\\\\Users\\\\Public\\\\.*")))
